# `igdev completion`

completion writes the autocompletion script for one shell on stdout. Load it from your
shell rc file, for example:

  # ~/.bashrc
  source <(igdev completion bash)

  # ~/.zshrc  (after: mkdir -p ~/.zfunc && adding "autoload -Uz compinit" && compinit)
  igdev completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_igdev

Supported shells: bash, zsh, fish, powershell. The script is data, not an envelope, so it is
written verbatim and never depends on --json.

## Usage

```text
igdev completion <shell> [flags]
```

## Examples

```text
  igdev completion bash
  igdev completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_igdev"
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for completion
```

## Global options

```text
      --config stringArray   override one config key for this run, key=value (highest precedence)
      --json                 emit the JSON envelope on stdout (machine mode)
```

## Agent usage

the completion script is data, not an envelope: it is written verbatim to
stdout whether or not --json is set, so capture it unconditionally and write it to the
shell's completion directory. An unsupported or missing shell name is IGDEV_E_USAGE at
exit 2. An agent driving an argv-shaped interface has no use for it.
